source_read: https://www.cocodimama.co.uk/menus and the menu page of every restaurant and delivery kitchen in its sitemap (12 restaurants + 136 delivery kitchens = 148 pages), downloaded 2026-10-10 23:50-23:58 UTC; central /menus SHA-256 13526579b9fadc1329033dfeec1fd65453270c26750cb60890b14a771aea259d. robots.txt (RFC 9309 matcher): User-agent * Allow / ; Disallow /api/ /studio/ /bookings/share/ /_next/. No other host contacted. The nutrition/allergen PDFs on cdn.sanity.io (robots: Disallow /*.pdf) were not used.
method: Fresh copies of 4 pages were downloaded with curl on 2026-10-10 (restaurant London Monument; delivery kitchens Leicester and Hampton Court = the 110-site delivery menu; Abingdon = the 25-site delivery menu) and read offline in headless Chromium with JavaScript off and every network request aborted (innerText of each dish card: name, 'NNN kcal', Vegetarian/Vegan chips), a different method from the script's regex parse of its own cache. 31 published rows picked by rule (lowest and highest calories, then the middle row and the second row of every category, delivery rows included) were compared name by name and number by number, plus the vegetarian tag against the page's chips.
not_verifiable: allergens: none published (the chain's allergen source is a PDF on a host whose robots.txt disallows it; the per-dish allergen list in the page's script data is not shown on the page and was not used). Pasta is not published at all: the restaurant menu says 'Kcals shown are for sauce only', so the number is not the dish (24 names), and the delivery menu's pasta pots (24 names) print sauce-sized numbers without saying what they cover.
notes: Calories-only chain. In the script's own checks every dish's rendered 'NNN kcal' equals the number in the page's script data (all 148 pages), the central page's JSON-LD agrees with its rendered text for all 182 names, and the central page agrees with the 12 restaurants. The 136 delivery kitchens print three different menus (110 / 25 / 1 sites; the 1 is Canary Wharf, which prints the restaurant menu): a dish name printed with two values is left out of the delivery menu (9 dishes, e.g. 'Nduja Mozzarella Garlic Bread 731 at 110 sites and 897 at 25; Margherita Pinsa 438 at Canary Wharf, 462 at 110 delivery kitchens), and the 175 dishes only Canary Wharf prints are left out of it too (the restaurants' own menu publishes them where it has them). Hot-drink calories are based on whole dairy milk where applicable (the page says so).
